items.title: Netherlands amends tax penalty rules to support Pillar Two, DAC8, DAC9 rollout
items.summary: The Netherlands has gazetted Decision No. 2026-14582 of 30 July 2026 on 7 August 2026, bringing amendments to the Decree on Administrative Fines of the Tax and Customs Administration (BBBB). These changes primarily adapt the administrative penalty rules to support the implementation of three major European directives: the Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax (Directive (EU)...
